description: Source jobs queue case/with exhaustiveness warnings through world.emit_warning_once, but fz2 run/interp/build product pulls run jobs directly and never flush world.flush_reported_warnings(). Acceptance: product-drive paths emit queued type/no-matching-clause warnings; case_tuple_pattern_sequential diagnostic fixture can be undeferred for run/interp/build where the warning is already produced; cargo test --lib and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings pass.
title: Product drive flushes queued source diagnostics before returning products
